paragraphs.text: Matthew "Matt" Sernett is a writer and game designer for Wizards of the Coast . He is mostly concerned with Dungeons & Dragons but also has contributed to Magic: The Gathering .

Credits include Player’s Handbook Races: Tieflings and The Plane Above: Secrets of the Astral Sea . Besides working on D&D miniatures , Matt was also lead designer for Spell Compendium, Tome of Magic , Hellspike Prison , and the new Dungeons & Dragons Basic Game . He contributed work to Tome of Battle , Player's Handbook II , Complete Mage , Complete Scoundrel , and a big project for Forgotten Realms . Before that, Matt did a fair amount of freelancing was Editor in Chief of Dragon .
